notes_OniEz2: batch: language fixes surfaced by the chart_* error profiles (all 53 chart cases reference_compile_failed on the stale oracle while their goldens exist, so fixing our compiler is directly golden-checkable). (1) REAL PARSER BUG: the modifier scanner recorded `const` as m += MOD.Static() (16), so `static const` stacked to 32 == MOD.Virtual() - const fields became bogus virtual INSTANCE fields (layout slot + no qualified read). One-line `|` fix; eliminated 312 of the 374 chart unknown-field errors. (2) qualified static field chains type through StaticTyOf/ExprCls (Store.items.Count); unsupported-index-target family cleared. (4) base.Method(args): nearest base-chain implementation, this as receiver, nonvirtual BL (ResolveBaseImplNg). (5) CallRetTy member calls resolve through the receiver's class chain before the global name table (SignalString.Get vs SignalInt.Get were picked by registration order). (6) Contains renders numerically in WriteLine per the gen0 model (string/List Contains is a 0/1 probe) - latent divergence exposed when log_rolling_file first compiled; now byte-exact vs golden (true/true/0/1/1). chart_kinds_complete error profile 524 -> 80; remaining ~half is instance async methods (Worker.onDown family) plus cascades - next batch. notes_8ymewr: batch: await-family unlock (all edits in src/selfhost/ngen_async.zan). (1) await of a delegate VALUE (local/field/parameter -- the Worker.onDown family): IsDelegateCalleeNg promotes the AsyncResolveCallNg -1 fallback to -2 ONLY on the await paths (EmitAwaitNg head + TryGenAwaitExprNg sync path); the thunk dispatches to the method-group ramp yielding the frame handle and the general await reads SELF resume from the frame. Placing the check INSIDE AsyncResolveCallNg was a real bug caught by the sweep: PrepareAsyncStmtNg (Hook B, detach recognition) runs AsyncResolveCallNg on EVERY call statement, so delegate-valued statements like `sink(3);` were emitted as detached async calls and the void thunk return was later dereferenced as a frame handle (delegate_field_call SIGSEGV, 8 em + 2 om regressions + spurious co-runtime emission in non-async modules). Restored: pass 286 (+2), em/om/mne case lists identical to the run.OniEz2 baseline. (2) self-lowered suspension intrinsics (CoIntrinsicKindNg/EmitCoIntrinsicNg, IR-lane EmitSocketIntrinsic as spec): Gate.Park, Socket.ReadReady/WriteReady (immediate-ready on the native lane; interest 1/2 constant), RecvOv/RecvToOv (one libc recv, negative errno-style return propagates, timeout not enforced - documented), AcceptOv (libc accept, fails closed), ResolveSockAddr (IPv4 literal -> 16-byte darwin sockaddr_in via inet_pton, DNS names -> *outn=0 documented gap). resUsed=true is an error for the valueless kinds; value kinds deliver the frame+32 result slot. (3) the gate/io runtime is self-emitted inside EnsureAsyncRuntimeNg (guarded by asyncRtDone) so the DllImport EntryPoints (zan_gate_new/signal/free) bind locally: BLExtern scans local syms first. Gate = {head,tail,surplus} 24B, waiter {next,frame,step} 24B, surplus banking semantics per rt_io.c 5060-5160; gate_free drains waiters (no free on the native lane). Bugs found by probes: park enqueue kept the gate in x0 across the _zan_rt_alloc call (return value clobbered it - waiter self-looped, Signal never woke it; fixed by spilling the gate), and rev16 was encoded as REV (0x5AC00C21 vs 0x5AC00421) - SIGILL inside _zan_resolve_sa_co. Probes: delegate await local+field (qa1), Gate park/signal/surplus/closed round trip (qa2), recv/accept -1 propagation + sockaddr bytes 16,2,31,144,127 for 127.0.0.1:8080 + DNS -> 0 (qa3) all correct. chart_kinds_complete honest profile (run from zan-selfhost so the stdlib resolves; the earlier 34-error reading was an artifact of running from tests/conformance where the relative-stdlib fallback finds nothing): 81 -> 44. Remaining chart families: Get$T explicit generic specs (8), delegate capture/7-param shapes (6), Html Dictionary<Action> (3), awaited DllImports NativeResolveAllAsync/NativeConnectSockAddr (2, blocking-extern lowering per irgen_expr.c:7969), FindNotAnyOf (2), Task.Delay-arg + ToStr-arity cascades, Interop Com. Sweep deltas: pass 284 -> 286; 17 cases left ncf (184); 15 of them now COMPILE but need the thread-runtime extern surface (_zan_thread_*/monitor/semaphore families: atomic_shared_table, blocking_queue_fault, thread_* etc.) - crt-transition stub expansion is the next batch's prerequisite, not a regression. Verification: probes qa1/qa2/qa3 + dfc regression probe; 39/39; crossboot ELF 5/5 + PE-COFF 5/5; formal bootstrap run.8ymewr stage2.o==stage3.o; full sweep below.
notes_dfN3PV: batch: thread-runtime unlock, three parts. (1) crt-transition/zanstubs.c grew the 45 Threading DllImport symbols, semantics ported from oracle src/runtime/rt_sync.c: zan_thread_start (pthread_create detached; our lane's ThreadStart delegate object is {fn@0, env@8}, invoked fn(env), no refcounting - nm confirms the lane has no _zan_delegate_* refs) + zan_thread_current_id (pthread_threadid_np, same as the oracle's macOS branch); 7 zan_atomic_int_* (C11 __atomic SEQ_CST on a malloc'd int64; add returns the new value, compare_exchange returns the old); 36 zan_shared_table_* as a single-process honest port (in-memory named registry + heap columnar rows; schema 'i:n;/'f:n;'/'s:size:n;' with string size+1 for the NUL exactly like zan_parse_schema, duplicate columns rejected, int/float align8; FNV-1a 64 forced-nonzero hashing shared by hash() and the _at family; wall-clock expiry with oracle purge semantics; rate_allow/lock_acquire/lock_release/extreme_at/match_at algorithms ported line-by-line incl. the INT 'count'/'window_start'/'owner' columns and create-only-if-absent locking; 7/8 load-factor insert refusal; stat maps RESERVED/RESIDENT to stride*cap, honest -1/0/empty-string on misses; OsHandle/Attach fail cleanly = 0 since the transition runtime has no cross-process carrier; tables deliberately never freed so handles can't dangle). (2) PER-THREAD EH: exception_threads caught _zan_rt_eh_state caching its state block behind one process-global - with real threads a thread could longjmp into a slot armed by another thread. RtEmitEhState (ngen_obj.zan) now just tail-calls the new zan_eh_tls_state in zanstubs.c (static __thread storage, same compiler-owned {i32 top, ptr exc, 256x1024} layout; scripts/crossboot/stub.c serves a static block for the single-threaded qemu guest). Mach-O extern names need the leading underscore in BLExtern - the no-underscore spelling broke every link until fixed (ELF strips exactly one underscore, so one spelling serves both). (3) REAL lock MONITORING: monitor_striped exposed the parser lowering `lock (e) body` to a plain block (written pre-threads). Parser now emits AK.LockStmt; ngen GenLockStmt desugars after checking to { var $lockN = obj; monitor_enter($lockN); try body finally monitor_exit($lockN) } over the striped recursive zan_monitor_enter/exit ported from rt_sync.c (64 stripes, pointer-fold hash, re-entrancy legal). Riding the real try machinery gives the oracle's exact release discipline (irgen_stmt.c AST_LOCK_STMT): throw releases at the throw site, return/break/continue via the pending-fin walk, nested unwind lands in the lock's own armed buf. Two ngen bugs found by probes and fixed: (a) the lock temp slot was added during emission, after frame = 16*nloc froze - it wrote outside the frame (qa4/qa11/qa13 SEGV, probe bisection: inline loop fine, loop-in-method + later try crashed); fixed by allocating the slot in ReserveLocals' LockStmt arm and stashing the decl node in s.c; (b) HasTry didn't see LockStmt, so curHasTry stayed false and the #ehtop/#ehbase/#ehbrk slots + state-top mirror init were skipped entirely; HasTry now counts LockStmt. Probes: qa4 (single-thread lock/reentrancy/throw-release), qa5 (plain nested try/finally baseline), qa6 (real try/finally inside lock), qa8 (lock no-throw + throw shapes), qa10/qa11/qa12/qa13 (loop x300/x1000 inline vs cross-method) all byte-exact; monitor_striped 40000/40000/reentrant x3 stable. Sweep: pass 286 -> 301 (+15 = every former nlf case), nlf 15 -> 0, om/em/mne case lists identical to baseline (om stays the three oracle-staleness attributions), ncf unchanged at 184. Verification: 39/39, crossboot ELF 5/5 + PE-COFF 5/5, formal bootstrap run.dfN3PV stage2.o==stage3.o, full sweep below.
